title: Analyst – Private Funds Group, EMEA Secondary Advisory

titleByLocale.it: Analista – Private Funds Group, EMEA Secondary Advisory

titleByLocale.de: Analyst – Private Funds Group, EMEA Secondary Advisory
titleByLocale.fr: Analyste – Private Funds Group, EMEA Secondary Advisory

descriptionByLocale.it:
As a member of the Private Funds Group (PFG), within Global Banking, the EMEA Secondary Advisory product team partner with Sector and Country coverage teams to execute a full suite of GP-led liquidity solutions for financial sponsor clients. The market-leading group is also integrated within a best-in-class primary placement business offering deep investor connectivity. Key Responsibilities •Develop and maintain detailed financial models, including: o Asset-level LBO analyses o Fund and Continuation vehicle waterfalls o Sensitivity analyses and return benchmarking
• Work alongside coverage teams to assist in valuation analysis across multiple methodologies (for e.g. trading comparable and precedent transactions) including a review of the sponsor case underwriting •Prepare marketing materials, including pitch presentations, information memoranda, financial analyses and investor materials •Support management of due diligence processes, data room coordination and investor Q&A •Conduct secondary investor universe mapping across European and global secondary buyers •Coordinate with commercial, financial, legal, tax and structuring advisors across multiple jurisdictions
